arguments_redacted.content: The bug in the `top_scores` function was that it did not handle the case where the input list `scores` has fewer than three elements. This can lead to an `IndexError` when trying to slice the list. To correct the ordering, we added a check to ensure that the list has at least three elements before slicing it. If it has fewer than three elements, we return the entire list sorted.
